# netactuate_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a DNS Record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_dns_record" "example" {
  content = "192.0.2.10"
  type    = "A"
  zone_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) DNS record content
- `type` (String) DNS record type
- `zone_id` (Number) Parent DNS zone ID

### Optional

- `name` (String) DNS record name
- `priority` (Number) DNS record priority
- `ttl` (Number) DNS record TTL

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) The fully qualified name of the record, as the API reports it
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_dns_record.example 12345
```
